attorneys: Geo. L. Vaughn and Herman Wilier for petitioners. Benjamin F. York for respondents. Luther Ely Smith and Victor B. Harris filed a brief for the St. Louis Civil Liberties Committee, as amicus curiae, in support of the petition.

opinions.text:
*803The petition for writ of certiorari to the Supreme Court of Missouri is granted.

Mr. Justice Reed took no part in the consideration or decision of this application.
